goal: Break up the monolithic 1,500-line P2P message processing function into dedicated helper functions
Make message handling logic easier to navigate and review for maintainers
agreement: Strong support across multiple reviewers for modularizing message processing
Verified move-only refactoring with git color-moved and local coverage testing (pseudoramdom, l0rinc)
Supports refactoring because it improves navigation and diff readability (stickies-v, maflcko)
Withdrew concern that separate helpers add caller ambiguity after other reviewers preferred it (davidgumberg)
Suggested deferring merge until a conflicting backport candidate merges (maflcko)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is a move-only refactoring that provides maintainability and navigability gains
It addresses no functional bugs, protocol features, or DoS risks, making it cleanly deferrable
